title: Debug mode enabled in python — review required
description: Debug mode is switched on in python, either through a framework setting or the development server launch call. Debug builds expose stack traces, interactive consoles, configuration values, and sometimes remote code paths that production must never serve. This lexical rule flags the switch; whether the file is production configuration is a review decision.
remediation: Force debug off outside local development, drive it from an environment variable that defaults to false, and assert the production setting at start-up.
limitation: Lexical: matches literal debug assignments and run-call flags; configuration merged from other files is out of scope.
